LASTARC.TechnickFlag.weaponFinesse: Weapon Finesse — substitute Agility for Strength on light, thrown, unarmed and natural attacks
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.preciseShot: Precise Shot — negates the penalty for shooting into melee
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.tripleCrit: Triple Crit — ranged critical multiplier becomes ×3
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.doubledExplosions: Doubled Explosions — each exploding die generates two rather than one
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.combatCasting: Combat Casting — multiple threats reduced to a single −5
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.brawler: Brawler — unarmed attacks no longer provoke
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.shieldProficiency: Shield Proficiency — cumulative block penalty capped at −5
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.hardyAndHearty: Hale and Hearty — removes the once-per-encounter Second Wind cap
LASTARC.TechnickFlag.debilitatingInjury: Debilitating Injury — damage over Threshold worsens the gauge by two steps
LASTARC.Tooltip.WieldDerived: Wield category, derived from your size against the weapon's.
LASTARC.Tooltip.WeaponUnusable: This weapon is two or more size categories larger than you and cannot be used.
LASTARC.Card.Combo: Combo — one free extra attack with the same weapon and target
LASTARC.Card.Critical: Critical — weapon damage dice are doubled
LASTARC.Card.ReactionWindow: The target may still Block or Dodge — these are opposed reactions and are not bypassed by an automatic hit.
LASTARC.Card.DiceCapped: Explosion cascade hit the dice cap and was truncated.
LASTARC.Card.Downed: reduced to 0 HP — unconscious, prone and helpless
LASTARC.Error.WeaponGone: That weapon is no longer on the actor.
LASTARC.Warning.NoTargets: No targets selected. Target one or more tokens first.
LASTARC.Warning.WeaponUnusable: {weapon} is too large for {actor} to use.
LASTARC.Warning.ComboCapped: Combo chain reached the configured cap of {cap} and was stopped.
LASTARC.Note.NoTechnicks: No technicks or talents yet. Drag them here from a compendium.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ToggleEquip: Equip or unequip. Only one armour and one shield can be equipped at a time.
LASTARC.Note.Grants: Numeric effects entered here are applied to the character automatically. Behavioural effects belong in flags or an Active Effect instead.
LASTARC.Note.NpcDefences: Enter the printed statblock values. The Break Gauge penalty is applied on top automatically.
LASTARC.Note.SpellTripleDuty: The Spellcraft check does triple duty: it determines success, scales damage by how high it rolls, and may inflict a status if it also beats a second defence.
LASTARC.Note.WieldNeedsActor: Wield category depends on the wielder's size, so it is shown only when this weapon is owned by an actor.
LASTARC.Tooltip.MaxAgiBonus: Hard cap on the Agility contribution to Reflex. Leave blank for no cap.
LASTARC.Tooltip.CheckPenalty: Enter as a positive number. It is subtracted from affected skills, and only when the wearer is not proficient with this armour type.
LASTARC.Tooltip.InitiativeSteps: Improved Initiative steps the die DOWN the ladder, because the lowest initiative acts first.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PrintedValue: The printed statblock value, before the Break Gauge.
LASTARC.Tooltip.FlatFootedOverride: Statblocks print this in parentheses. Leave blank to derive it as Ref minus the Agility bonus.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ThresholdOverride: Leave blank to derive Threshold from Fortitude.
LASTARC.Dialog.DeleteItem.title: Delete item?
LASTARC.Field.Name: Name
LASTARC.Break.AppliesTo: Applies to attacks, defences, skill checks, and attribute checks
LASTARC.Tooltip.ClearPersistent: Mark this condition cured. The step becomes ordinary and can then be recovered normally.
LASTARC.Tooltip.InjuryStep: Steps from injuries do not block natural healing, unlike other persistent conditions.
LASTARC.Warning.NaturalHealingBlocked: Natural healing is blocked while a non-injury persistent condition or an HP-affecting status is active.
LASTARC.Warning.RecoveryDisabled: Recovery actions are unavailable — disease blocks them entirely.
LASTARC.Dialog.AddPersistent.title: Add persistent Break condition
LASTARC.Dialog.AddPersistent.content: Each persistent step has its own source and its own clearance requirement, and each must be cleared separately.
LASTARC.Dialog.AddPersistent.fromInjury: From an injury (does not block natural healing)
LASTARC.HeroPoint.MisfortuneBlocks: Misfortune prevents rerolling d20s, including with a hero point.
LASTARC.Note.WeaponSkills: Weapon skills cannot Take 10 or Take 20. A natural 1 always fails and a natural 20 always succeeds, regardless of modifiers.
LASTARC.Tooltip.InitiativeInverted: Initiative is a class die, not a d20. Lowest result acts first; ties go to the higher Agility score.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SecondWind: Minor action, once per day. Cannot be used above half maximum HP.
LASTARC.Tooltip.Threshold: Break Threshold = Fortitude + size + technicks + items. Derived live, so each Break step lowers it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SetBreakStep: Set the Break Gauge to this step
LASTARC.Tooltip.Recovery: Three consecutive minor actions improve the gauge by one step. Any other action — including a reaction — resets progress.
LASTARC.Dialog.RemoveFirstClass.title: Remove first class?
LASTARC.Dialog.RemoveFirstClass.content: The first class determines the character's level-1 HP and Mana grant and their class defence bonuses. Removing it promotes the next class into that role, which will change those values.
LASTARC.Info.RecoveryBanked: Recovery: {banked} of {required} consecutive minor actions banked.
LASTARC.Warning.Incapacitated: {name} is at the bottom of the Break Gauge and cannot act.
LASTARC.Warning.WeaponSkillTakeN: Weapon skills cannot Take 10 or Take 20.
LASTARC.Warning.PersistentFloor: Recovery cannot clear persistent steps. This character is held at step {steps} until the underlying condition is cured.
LASTARC.Warning.RecoveryBlocked: Already at the persistent floor — recovery cannot improve the gauge further.
LASTARC.Warning.SecondWind: Second Wind is unavailable: either already used, or HP is above half maximum.
LASTARC.Warning.LevelMismatch: Class levels do not sum to the character's total level.
LASTARC.Setting.breakThresholdUsesPostDR: Whether a hit is compared to Break Threshold before or after Damage Reduction is subtracted. The rules are ambiguous (spec §15 A1) and this changes every Break Gauge interaction in the game. Default: after DR.
LASTARC.Setting.heroPointAffectsThreshol: Hero point defence boost raises Break Threshold
A hero point adds 1d6 to a defence. Break Threshold is defined as Fortitude, so this reads as also raising the Threshold mid-turn (spec §15 A2). Default: yes.
LASTARC.Setting.clampAttributeModifier.h: The book states modifiers span −5 to +5, but racial caps reach 22, which computes to +6 (spec §15 A3). Default: clamp.
LASTARC.Setting.multiclassRegrantsLevel1: Whether a second class grants its own defence bonuses, starting technicks and gold (spec §15 A9). Default: no — granted on the first class only.
LASTARC.Setting.maxComboChain.name: Maximum Combo chain length
LASTARC.Setting.maxComboChain.hint: A melee natural 20 grants a free extra attack, which can itself roll a natural 20. The rules do not state a limit (spec §15 A6); this caps the chain defensively.
LASTARC.Tooltip.HeroBoost: Spend a hero point: add an exploding 1d6 to this defence until the start of your next turn. Boosting Fortitude also raises Break Threshold.
LASTARC.Action.DowngradeHint: primary → secondary or minor; secondary → minor
LASTARC.Action.Unaffordable: No action slot available for that.
LASTARC.Action.NoReactionsFlatFooted: Reactions are blocked entirely while flat-footed.
LASTARC.Action.NoFreeActionsFlatFooted: Free actions cannot be used while flat-footed, except spending a hero point.
LASTARC.Action.SequenceInterrupted: Sequence interrupted — {banked} banked minor action(s) lost.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SlotPrimary: Primary action. May be downgraded to a secondary or a minor action.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SlotSecondary: Secondary action. May be downgraded to a minor action.
LASTARC.Tooltip.HoldTurn: Defer to the next combatant. This permanently reorders the tracker for the rest of combat — it is not a one-round delay.
LASTARC.Combat.Held: holds their turn, deferring to the next combatant. The tracker order is permanently changed.
LASTARC.Combat.HoldLast: Already last in the turn order — there is nobody to defer to.
LASTARC.Combat.GroupInitiative: Group initiative ({die}) — the group moves at the pace of its slowest member.
LASTARC.Note.NoAttacks: No attacks. Add one to roll it from this sheet.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RollNpcAttack: Roll this attack. Target a token first to compare against its Reflex — a flat-footed target uses its flat-footed value.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AttackBroken: The printed bonus is the creature's UNBROKEN value. The Break Gauge penalty is applied on top.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AreaNoCrit: Area attacks can neither crit nor combo (§5.1).
LASTARC.Dialog.DeleteAttack.title: Delete Attack
LASTARC.Warning.NoSuchAttack: {name} has no attack at that position — the sheet may be out of date. Close and reopen it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AdjustmentColumn: Everything affecting this skill that has no column of its own — Break Gauge, armour check penalty, technick bonuses, and granted training or focus. Hover any row to itemise it.
LASTARC.Note.NoSpells: No spells known. Add one, or drag it in from a compendium.
LASTARC.HighArcana.adamant: Adamant Spell — ignore Break Gauge penalties to the Spellcraft check
LASTARC.HighArcana.distant: Distant Spell — double the spell’s range
LASTARC.HighArcana.enlarged: Enlarged Spell — double the targeted area, not secondary effects
LASTARC.HighArcana.intensified: Intensified Spell — double the number of damage dice
LASTARC.HighArcana.lingering: Lingering Spell — double duration, scaling durations only
LASTARC.HighArcana.multi: Multi-Spell — target extra creatures equal to your Mnd modifier
LASTARC.Card.DecayTick: {amount} at the start of their turn in {n}
LASTARC.Warning.UnknownStatus: This spell applies an unregistered status ({id}). Add it to the status tables.
LASTARC.Tooltip.CastSpell: Cast this spell. Target a token first to compare against its defence.
LASTARC.Tooltip.HighArcana: High Arcana double the MP cost and cannot be stacked. Any MP reduction applies after the doubling.
LASTARC.Card.SpellDisrupted: {spell} was disrupted by a counterattack — the spell fails and {cost} MP is wasted.
LASTARC.Tooltip.Rest: Rest to recover HP and MP. Eight hours within 24 also restores per-day abilities; more than eight yields nothing extra.
LASTARC.Dialog.Rest.title: Rest
LASTARC.Dialog.Rest.blocked: A persistent condition prevents HP recovery from rest.
LASTARC.Card.PerformSkillBonus: Allies gain {n} to all weapon skills until the start of your next turn.
LASTARC.Card.SubstitutesDefence: Allies may use {total} in place of their {defence} Defence until the start of your next turn.
LASTARC.Card.PerformanceReplaces: A creature carries one allied and one enemy performance at most; a new one of the same side replaces the old.
LASTARC.Card.PerformanceDisrupted: {name} was disrupted by a counterattack — the performance fails.
LASTARC.Tooltip.Perform: Perform. Shift-click to perform defensively (Instrument −5, Dance and Oratory −2, per threatening creature).
LASTARC.HeroPoint.RerollTooltip: Spend a hero point to reroll this d20. You keep the second result even if it is worse.
LASTARC.HeroPoint.Rerolled: Hero point spent — rerolled {original} into {rerolled}, keeping {kept}.
LASTARC.HeroPoint.BonusRollTooltip: Spend a hero point to add an exploding 1d6 to this result. Keeps the original die, so it cannot make the roll worse.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.enlarged: Targeted area doubled — secondary effects are not extended.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.lingering: Duration doubled, where the duration scales.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.multi: May target additional creatures equal to your Mnd modifier.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.multiInapplicabl: Multi-Spell has no effect: it only works on spells that target a single creature.
LASTARC.Injury.severedLeg: Severed leg — −5 Agi checks, speed and max bulk halved, cannot charge
LASTARC.Injury.severedArm: Severed arm — −5 Str and Agi checks, no two-handed weapons, reload one step slower
LASTARC.Injury.Permanent: A missing limb cannot be restored — only a prosthetic reduces the penalties.
